profile: native independent requirements and boundary design
scope: UI-local transient creation followed by eligible durable creation; no repository edits or tests in this planning turn

responsibilities.pure_ui_model: Transient identity, kind, frozen creation context, raw editable values, dirty provenance, eligibility, dependency graph, lifecycle and receipt remapping. No clock, UUID allocation, DOM or HTTP effects.
responsibilities.ui_application: 500ms debounce and serial dependency ordering through existing injected timers/call/ID ports. At most one retained create request per transient object. Never send temporary IDs to public APIs.
responsibilities.dom_adapter: Render local rows and the ordinary typed inspector, bind IME to its original temporary object, retain date/time raw proposals and accessible errors, and move focus only if matching current invocation/selection.
responsibilities.backend: Shared public populated creation remains one atomic caller request. Tighten new catalog create/edit names to nonempty without invalidating existing blank stored rows or rewriting applied migrations, receipts or migration ledger. Action title may stay empty for notes-only creation.

eligibility.action: Nonwhitespace title OR nonwhitespace notes, plus valid editable fields and resolvable saved dependency references. Persist exact raw notes; do not invent a title. Flags/dates/classification alone do not trigger creation.
eligibility.project_tag: Valid nonempty trimmed name, plus valid description and resolvable saved parent dependency. Description-only is retained but ineligible.
eligibility.dirty_provenance: Distinguish inherited/default creation context and displayed defaults from genuine user editing. Untouched empty objects may purge; any genuinely edited object, including a later-cleared or invalid proposal, is retained until explicit discard.
eligibility.persisted: Eligibility and purge rules apply only before the first durable creation. A persisted record is never deleted merely because editable content becomes blank.

scenarios.given: Any supported current view and explicit creation context
scenarios.then: Insert one UI-local temporary row and open its inspector with no DB write, revision increment, receipt or server UUID allocation. Preserve contextual containment/direct classification without inferring meaning from perspective filters.

Remove that local object with zero writes. Default contextual Project/Tag, lifecycle and date suggestions alone do not count as user edits or commit eligibility. Do not purge a dependency of an edited child; retain it as a required unresolved local ancestor.

scenarios.given: Temporary Action with substantive title or notes, or catalog with valid nonempty name
scenarios.when: Debounce completes, blur or in-app navigation flushes
scenarios.then: Create through the existing serial mutation lane once dependencies are durable and all submitted fields are valid. Capture the exact proposal and immutable request identity. Notes-only Action commits with empty saved title and exact notes.

scenarios.given: User edited only a flag, date, classification, catalog description, invalid field or then cleared meaningful content
scenarios.when: Refresh, filter/view change, close or back
scenarios.then: Retain the local proposal and reachable re-entry without saving or erasing genuine input. Invalid raw clock/calendar input remains bound to that temporary identity. No automatic discard based only on final empty values.

scenarios.given: Temporary child or classification references another temporary object
scenarios.when: Child becomes eligible before its parent/catalog
scenarios.then: Keep the child pending with its exact dependency. Commit eligible dependencies first, remap their returned UUIDs, then create the child. Ineligible dependency blocks creation; never detach to root or send temporary IDs. Discard of a referenced temporary object requires explicit handling of its retained dependents.

scenarios.given: IME composing on a temporary object
scenarios.when: Debounce, blur, Add or navigation occurs
scenarios.then: No premature durable creation from intermediate composition. Capture final text for the original object, preserve later navigation intent and apply ordinary eligibility after composition ends.

scenarios.given: A temporary create is in flight and newer edits/navigation occur
scenarios.when: A typed matching receipt and normal snapshot return
scenarios.then: Remap temporary identity to exact server UUID across rows, children/catalog references, drafts/baselines, date raw state, retained routes and current selection. Acknowledge only captured fields; preserve newer edits and queue their eligible updates. Do not steal newer selection or navigation.

Keep the original temporary object, immutable operation ID/arguments, captured proposal and callback. Block duplicate creation; retry exact request only. Applied receipt plus failed snapshot read retains recovery gate; valid typed receipt plus normal snapshot lacking subsequently removed object confirms unavailable rather than recreating it.

scenarios.given: An already persisted Action or existing blank legacy catalog record
scenarios.then: No transient purge. Ordinary Action edits retain existing empty-title semantics. New catalog names require nonempty validation; old blank rows remain readable and can be renamed without fabricated values or migration rollback.

scenarios.given: Authorized caller LLM supplies populated Action title/notes/classification
scenarios.then: One request creates populated durable Action with existing atomic owner/revision/receipt/Undo semantics. UI transient identity and eligibility do not become backend workflow policy.

counterexamples: Add allocates server UUID or writes a blank object immediately.
Title-only eligibility rejects substantive notes-only Action.
Flag/date/default context triggers empty Action persistence.
Closing loses a genuinely edited but ineligible or invalid local object.
Empty parent purges while an edited child still references it.
Child commits under root because temporary parent is ineligible.
Temporary identity reaches API arguments or SQL.
Late receipt focuses a new object after explicit newer selection/navigation.
Acknowledgment replaces newer local text or raw date/time state.
Unknown retry allocates fresh operation ID or creates a second object.
Clearing a persisted record silently removes it.
Already applied 0014 is removed, replayed destructively, ledger changed or blank legacy names replaced with invented text.
bounded_assumptions: Retained means surviving in-app Refresh, navigation, filters and host notification, matching current draft-retention guarantees; durable recovery across a complete browser reload is not added by this contract.
Untouched temporary purge is allowed only when no edited dependent requires it; this exception prevents data loss without inferring content for the parent.
Any invalid submitted Action/catalog field blocks that object's create so a partial valid subset is not silently persisted.
No new server-side placeholder state, draft table, auto naming, recommendation logic or background writer is introduced.
